sources.title: Luca Chiantini, Generalized Weddle loci, OWR 54/2022
sources.historical_inspection_scope: Original definition at printed p.3102 and Question 1 at p.3103, independently checked; neighboring Question 2 distinguished. DOI: https://doi.org/10.4171/owr/2022/54.

sources.title: Chiantini, Farnik, Favacchio, Harbourne, Migliore, Szemberg and Szpond, Weddle schemes
sources.historical_inspection_scope: Sections 1–7 inspected; central Sections 3 and 5 in detail; appendices for target separation. Printed large matrices were inspected, not independently recomputed. Conjecture 5.4 wording independently checked by images, OCR, PDF extraction, rerender comparison and primary HTML.
sources.status: Preprint; the inspected landing page exposed v1 and no later version. No journal publication or later full resolution was verified in the bounded historical search.
sources.proof_dependency_limit: Only the definition and projection interpretation are used; Theorem 5.1, Propositions 5.2, 5.3 and 5.6, and Conjecture 5.4 are not assumed.
